notes.title: Monument Valley 3 is OUT NOW

notes.title: Stream the Monument Valley 3 Soundtrack Now
notes.notes:
[p]We’re delighted to share that the official Monument Valley 3 digital soundtrack is now available to stream on [url="https://open.spotify.com/album/1O8s3BqsAmrczfIkcWCDkl?si=TdUX6f1kTmSB4kdd_9DFYQ"]Spotify[/url], [url="https://music.apple.com/us/album/monument-valley-3-original-game-soundtrack/1816219122"]Apple Music[/url], [url="https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=R9KeQfaXFqo&list=OLAK5uy_lWAsA69NFUfog1nk28tZPoSCdow5OC120"]YouTube Music[/url] and more.[/p][p][/p][p]For Monument Valley 3, we didn’t just see game audio as a backdrop, but as an integral and emotionally resonant part of the player experience. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="R9KeQfaXFqo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Whether you’re wanting to revisit your experience of playing Monument Valley 3, or simply looking for a moment of calm in your day, we hope this music offers you a place to pause, reflect and breathe. [/p][p]And of course, you're also still able to stream the soundtracks to [url="https://open.spotify.com/album/1DVCNAcMAd2eCgOmC84m2P"]Monument Valley[/url], [url="https://open.spotify.com/album/1dKwykVXwQ59ehjUxFKRRw"]Monument Valley: Forgotten Shores [/url] and [url="https://open.spotify.com/album/0BRkQHI4BLdepnzr9QLRu1"]Monument Valley 2[/url] on all music streaming platforms too![/p][p]If you haven’t done so already, wishlisting Monument Valley 3 is the best way to support us and stay updated and across all our upcoming announcements as we prepare for launch.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3132930/Monument_Valley_3/"][/dynamiclink]Thank you for your continued support. We still have some more exciting announcements to share ahead of release. We will be in touch soon.
[/p][p]Your friends,[/p][p]ustwo games[/p]

notes.title: Monument Valley 1 and 2 finally come to PC in re-imagined 'panoramic editions'
notes.notes: Haunting puzzlers Monument Valley 1 and 2 finally release on PC today. The two games have been "reimagined from the ground up" and are now on Steam as polished-up 'panoramic editions', supporting ultra-wide aspect ratios and bundled with all previously released DLC... Read more.

notes.title: Monument Valley is finally coming to PC
notes.notes: Monument Valley is a simple, visually striking, and vaguely sad tale about a princess on a quest for forgiveness. It was released in 2014 for iOS and Android devices, and it was wonderful—one of my favorite mobile games of all time. Eight long years later, it, and the 2017 sequel, are finally coming to PC in the updated Panoramic Edition, with a new PC-specific control scheme and updated graphics supporting ultrawide displays... Read more.

notes.title: Monument Valley: Panoramic Editions 1 + 2 coming soon - wishlist now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465055/e8abd6a5505856b86868f5be7e27306eba9d0f99.png[/img]

[h2]Kicking off our ‘summer of ustwo games'; we are incredibly proud to present an entirely new way to play one of our most beloved titles, right here on Steam. [/h2]

[h3]Introducing… Monument Valley: Panoramic Collection[/h3]

Our Panoramic Collection consists of two brand new game releases from us -

[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1927720/Monument_Valley_Panoramic_Edition]Monument Valley: Panoramic Edition [/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1927740/Monument_Valley_2_Panoramic_Edition]Monument Valley 2: Panoramic Edition [/url]
[/list]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/9753427/sale/MonumentValleyPC]VISIT THE SALE PAGE HERE![/url]

Together, these editions create our Panoramic Collection. Built exclusively for PC and ultra-wide displays, these editions are reimagined from the ground up for keyboard and mouse/touchpad support, and feature every single world, add-on and DLC ever lovingly made. 

For some longtime fans of ours, you might be asking - [i]‘but why now?’ [/i]

And it’s a good question. [b]Here at ustwo games, we have never stopped loving Monument Valley[/b] - it's so important to who we are, and to this day, helps us drive forward as a studio with unity. What was initially an experiment quickly ended up becoming something more.

Now, we are excited about the opportunity to open up and expand the world of Monument Valley without any restrictions - this is the widest, richest, and most beautiful version of Monument Valley you can ever play. 

Thanks to everyone who has ever played, recommended, and shown Monument Valley to their friends and family and made Monument Valley grow into a world bigger than we ever could have imagined. Here’s to the world of illusions always expanding.

See you on 12 July. 

Your friends,

[b]ustwo games[/b]
